description: Several rich coding rows have no structured relevant provision reference.
recommended_handling: Retrieve and verify articles/annexes before scaling.

description: Monitoring, audit, surveillance and assurance overlap in the existing record.
recommended_handling: Keep action, function, mechanism and device separate; do not add a production category yet.

description: Insurance companies may be a supporting device rather than a regulatory intermediary.
recommended_handling: Retain as an unresolved actor edge and adjudicate against text.

description: Auditor and recognized self-regulatory body appear as alternative categories in one narrative.
recommended_handling: Branch the alternatives or establish an explicit OR relation.

description: Registry is simultaneously institutional context, regulator of registrars and selecting actor for specialist intermediaries.
recommended_handling: Use relationship-specific roles and retain identity separately.

description: Current function flags may not match the narrative action set (e.g., enforcement or auditing).
recommended_handling: Do not translate flags directly into relational rows without comparison.

description: Current workbook statements are normalized summaries, not consistently verbatim excerpts.
recommended_handling: Add direct excerpt field and evidence type to production candidate schema only after testing.

description: Required/authorized/optional status is not consistently structured in selected source rows.
recommended_handling: Capture deontic force at provision level.

description: A/B alone cannot represent R-I-T and reporting recipients without role collapse.
recommended_handling: Retain optional ACTOR_I and recipient/oversight positions.

description: Five purposive cases cannot establish prevalence or intercoder reliability.
recommended_handling: Run PILOT_02 with independent duplicate coding.
